title: Price and McMoneagle find aliens and humans working together inside Mount Hayes

tellings.quote: Pat Price and Joe Mcmongle had found um aliens and and humans working side by side as sort of an intelligence gathering place.

plain: Two remote viewers, people trained to try to see distant places with the mind alone, named Pat Price and Joe McMoneagle, are said to have found aliens and humans working side by side inside Mount Hayes in Alaska, running something like an intelligence-gathering post. A former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan tells Michels this second-hand, as what he understood the two men had found. If true, it would mean a hidden joint base of humans and non-humans on American soil.
